Class AbstractOrthographyVisitor

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.visitor.VisitorAdapter<OrthographyElement>
ca.phon.orthography.AbstractOrthographyVisitor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Visitor<OrthographyElement>
Direct Known Subclasses:
AutomaticTranscription.AutomaticTranscriptionVisitor, AutoTranscriber.AutoTranscriberVisitor, OrthoElementLocator, OrthographyTierElementFilter.OrthographyFilter, OrthoToXmlVisitor, OrthoWordExtractor, PhraseVisitor, TranscriptOrthographyVisitors.KeywordVisitor
public abstract class AbstractOrthographyVisitor extends VisitorAdapter<OrthographyElement>
Base class for OrthographyElement visitor which has a default implementation for every object which implements OrthographyElement
